summary: Moolec Science SA, a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that shareholders at an Extraordinary General Meeting on October 20, 2026 approved the voluntary winding-up of the company and appointment of Joint Voluntary Liquidators, with 98.4% of votes cast in favor. In connection, CEO Alejandro Antalich and CFO Valeria Falottico resigned, effective immediately following the filing; management and affairs transferred to the liquidators, displacing officers' executive powers. No price, premium or advisor terms stated. Watch liquidation distributions, creditor claims and residual asset realization; arb angle is recovery value versus any trading price.
